item.title: Homes abandoned, harvests failing: Haiti’s farmers rebuild amid violence, hunger and El Niño
item.description: Years of insecurity, violence perpetrated by murderous armed gangs and economic instability, combined with displacement, poor agricultural performance and climate shocks, have left millions of Haitians struggling to meet their food needs.
